title: The Fastest Road in the West
text: Construction of Willow Springs Raceway began in 1952, and the first race was held on November 23, 1953. The surface started out as oiled dirt and was paved by 1954. The 2.5-mile main track still has its original layout, and it earned the nickname The Fastest Road in the West. In 1996, California declared the raceway a Point of Historical Interest.
